previousMarketMetadata.title: Roadmark expanded Australian BEV road-vehicle market inventory
previousMarketMetadata.scope: All new battery-electric road vehicles in Australia: passenger cars, SUVs, people movers, vans, utes, light/medium/heavy trucks and buses. Motorcycles/scooters with cited road-use claims and specialist low-volume imports are open census categories. Universe remains unclosed.
notes: This is market-audit evidence, not a complete ranked specification dataset.
Stock labels describe source advertisements only when their configuration and new condition are supported; physical units and allocation remain separate. Demonstrators are not treated as new stock.
Trims are exact named configurations verified in sources, not necessarily all configurations if trimCoverage is partial.
Model year, source publication date and observation date are distinct.
No missing numeric specifications were inferred.
Counts include named equipment/package configurations and some future-delivery entries. They are not counts of all current Australian marketing grades or all immediately available vehicles.
User scope clarified 2026-10-10 to all new EV road-vehicle types. Rank by compatible class/measurement cohort; passenger metrics must not silently rank against buses/trucks.
Motorcycle/scooter offerings with supplier road-use claims are included; per-VIN/state registration and complete universe remain unverified.

Lexus ES350e/500e BEV family newly reconciled on 10 October 2026; this historical reconciliation is retained; the current audit contains231 model records, including unresolved/future/withdrawn entries, not231 currently buyable vehicles.

11:56 UTC: Five standard Segway/ZEEHO road-scooter configurations now have detailed, qualified catalogue records. Fresh AE4 retailer HTML succeeds; generic NEW retail availability is advertised, not VIN-verified stock. E110S remains outside detailed integration. Full motorcycle/scooter market audit remains incomplete.

11 October 2026: one exact advertised New FTN Streetdog 80 offer was identified and the SANY SE588 source evidence was refined. These targeted observations do not reverify the whole inventory or close the market audit.
